messages:
alex: Heads-up: running the quantized eval harness (bert-ql4) on the full benchmark set and the runner is saturating the worker queue + causing retries. Seen across 3 shards so far. logs attached below.

priya: Can you paste the exact runner command and the logs? Is CI failing too?

alex: Repro cmd: `./eval_runner --model=bert-ql4 --shards=8 --batch-size=16 --max-seq=512 --target=tokens`
Logs: ```2024-11-05T14:12:30Z runner.INFO Starting shard 3
2024-11-05T14:12:37Z worker.ERROR task failed: OOM trying to allocate kernel buffer
2024-11-05T14:12:37Z runner.WARN retrying task shard=3 attempt=1
2024-11-05T14:12:45Z queue.DEBUG depth=512 inflight=48
2024-11-05T14:13:01Z worker.INFO recovered; processing backlog
2024-11-05T14:13:03Z runner.ERROR too many retries; aborting job```

jamie: Hmm looks like backpressure + retry loop. Quantization reduced model size but increased kernel count/prefetch overhead on our runtime => per-token latency spike for certain seq lengths. That could explain OOMs when multiple batches are inflight.

marta: Do we have queue-length and retry_count exposed per-shard on Grafana? I only see global queue depth in the console. We need per-worker metrics to pinpoint shard hotspots.

rory: I just audited the retry change PR (marcus/runner-retries). We switched exponential backoff to fixed short backoff to reduce latency for transient GPU hiccups. That probably interacts poorly with queue depth — lots of immediate retries will amplify the backlog.

alex: Confirmed: disabling the new retry policy in local run removes the amplification. But still see periodic OOMs for seq>=512 with batch-size>=16. With batch-size=8 it completes but throughput drops 30%.

priya: We should also check eval metric definitions — maybe the harness is batching examples differently across shards and our aggregator skews the final score. Are p95/p99 latencies and tokens/s computed per-shard or globally?

jamie: Current code computes p95 per-worker then aggregates by taking median across workers (old artifact). For correctness we should merge raw latencies across shards and then compute percentiles globally. That can mask per-shard tail issues.

marta: Proposed immediate fixes: (1) revert fixed-short backoff -> exponential with jitter, (2) add per-shard queue depth metric, (3) limit max inflight batches per-worker (circuit breaker), (4) rerun quantized eval with batch-size sweep [4,8,16] and record eval_score (rouge/accuracy) and latency.

rory: +1. Also add a short-term CI gate: if any shard has retry_count > 10 within 10m, fail job and notify eng-ml channel before aborting. That prevents long silent runs.

devops-bot: CI: build 4021 failed on job eval/quant-nightly (see https://ci.redwood/4021). Error: runner: too many retries.

alex: Quick repro steps I used locally (so others can run): `./scripts/run_local_eval.sh bert-ql4 8 16 512` — include `--collector=raw` to dump per-sample latencies.

priya: For the metric definitions doc: we need to update eval-harness/metrics.md to state: "percentiles computed on merged raw sample latencies across all workers; throughput measured as total tokens / wall_time; eval_score deltas reported with 95% CI; regression alert threshold default = 2% absolute for top metrics." I'll open a tiny PR.

jamie: Also note quantization can change model outputs slightly. Add an eval job that runs casted FP32 baseline (same codepath but unquantized) side-by-side to compute the delta. We should have a toleration matrix by task (NLG vs classification).

marta: Scheduling: I'll own the per-shard metric work and a Grafana dashboard patch. alex / jamie can do the retry revert + inflight cap. rory will add CI gate. Priya will update metrics.md and the eval scoring aggregator. Let's sync tomorrow 11am.

alex: Thanks all — temporary mitigation: running batch-size=8 and disabling fixed-short retries; will re-run the full suite overnight and post results. :thumbsup:

priya: nice. Please paste the overnight run summary in this thread. If we see >2% regression in rouge/accuracy we'll trigger rollback to previous quantization profile.

ci-bot: Nightly run queued as job 4024. Notifying eng-ml on completion.

alex: (reaction :eyes:)
